title: Vade memory records (C-12)
description: Frozen contract C-12. The shapes stored by the `memory` module: `memories` (MemoryRecord), `staging` (StagingRecord) and `archive` (ArchiveRecord), plus the enums both M4b and C5a must share. This file describes rows, not a wire format: `embedding` never leaves the module and is opaque here on purpose. `status` is derived, not a column: active = a live memory row, superseded = `superseded_by IS NOT NULL`, archived = a row copied into `archive`, staging = a `staging` row.

tables.memories: CREATE TABLE memories(id, layer, namespace, session_id, text, tags, content_hash, embedding, importance, confidence, source, kind, evidence, verified_at, supersedes, superseded_by, hit_count, last_hit_at, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at); UNIQUE(layer, session_id, namespace, content_hash)
tables.staging: CREATE TABLE staging(id, text, namespace, kind, evidence, content_hash, seen_sessions, embedding, confidence, created_at); UNIQUE(kind, namespace, content_hash)
tables.archive: CREATE TABLE archive(id, payload, archived_at, reason)
tables.meta: CREATE TABLE meta(k, v) — embedding_model, dim
tables.consolidate_run: CREATE TABLE consolidate_run(run_id, last_run, kind, stats) — owned by M4a, read/written by M4b through store.py

invariants: session_id is NOT NULL DEFAULT '' — never NULL: SQLite treats NULLs as distinct, which would disable dedup on the global layer
session layer: namespace = '', session_id = <ULID>, expires_at = now + 7d
global layer: namespace = <namespace>, session_id = '', expires_at = null
UNIQUE includes session_id so two sessions writing the same text get two rows
a lesson row requires evidence; verified_at null means unverified
forget is a soft delete (deleted_at + archive(reason='forget')); TTL expiry is the only physical DELETE
quota eviction writes archive(reason='quota'); superseded rows have a negative score and are evicted first

Ulid.description: ULID, Crockford base32. Memory ids and session ids share this shape.

Source.description: Who wrote the row: an explicit tool call (`user`, importance 5), the evolver (`evolve`), or an import (`import`).

Status.description: Derived class the admin surface exposes; `staging` only ever describes a StagingRecord.

Evidence.description: Required for kind=lesson. `result_digest` is a digest of the tool result, never the raw text.

MemoryRecord.title: memories row
MemoryRecord.description: One live memory. `status`, `tags` and `evidence` are decoded views of the stored columns.

namespace.description: Global layer: the partition (`user:default`, `agent:x`, `project:y`). Session layer: always the empty string.

session_id.description: Session layer: the ULID core injected. Global layer: always the empty string (never null).

content_hash.description: sha256(layer + '\0' + session_id + '\0' + namespace + '\0' + normalized_text); normalized_text is strip() + whitespace folding only.

embedding.description: Opaque module-internal BLOB (numpy.float32.tobytes(), `memory.embedding_dim` floats). Never serialised by `memory/admin_*`.

evidence.description: Required when kind=lesson; null means the column is NULL.

verified_at.description: Unix seconds of the second verification; null = unverified.

supersedes.description: The id this row replaces (new -> old).

superseded_by.description: The id that replaced this row; non-null means soft-invalid and score-negative.

expires_at.description: Session-layer TTL; null on the global layer.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete (forget). Physically purged 7 days later on startup.

StagingRecord.title: staging row
StagingRecord.description: An unpromoted candidate written by the evolver; consolidate consumes it. Never visible to the model until promoted.

seen_sessions.description: JSON list of session ids that produced this candidate.

embedding.description: Computed at staging_put so consolidate can cluster; null means only string matching is possible.

ArchiveRecord.title: archive row
ArchiveRecord.description: The landing place for evicted and forgotten rows. Recoverable by definition; only `forget`/TTL physically DELETE, and TTL never archives.

payload.description: The serialised MemoryRecord as it was archived.

reason.description: Free text. The module writes `quota` (eviction), `forget` (soft delete) and `admin` (C5a archive RPC).
